_note: Example config only. All paths are placeholders. No real data paths, secrets, or machine-specific values.

guardrail_notes: Use generator-holdout or model_name-holdout validation to prevent data leakage.
Do not use random split as it risks train/val generator overlap.
architecture metadata is the primary supervision for family/provenance labels.

required_target_fields.tampered_mask: binary mask image or RLE; available only for tampered samples

datasets.family_provenance_note: SID-Set samples may not carry Community Forensics-Small family labels. During Stage 3 fine-tuning, apply one of: (1) freeze provenance head, (2) mask-out family loss for SID-Set samples, or (3) mix CF-Small mini-batches to maintain provenance supervision.
guardrail_notes: Do not apply family/provenance loss to SID-Set samples without verification that labels exist.
Incorrect family loss on SID-Set samples can corrupt provenance head training.

protected_path_rules.policy: All root and split paths in production configs must be set via environment substitution at runtime. Example configs use placeholder tokens only.
